events.title: Columbus makes landfall in the Bahamas
events.description: After 33 days crossing the Atlantic, Christopher Columbus's expedition landed on an island its Taíno inhabitants called Guanahani. The encounter began sustained contact between Europe and the Americas, with vast consequences for both.

events.title: Crown Prince Ludwig's wedding gives rise to Oktoberfest
events.description: Crown Prince Ludwig of Bavaria married Princess Therese of Saxe-Hildburghausen, and Munich's citizens were invited to celebrate on the fields before the city gates. The festivities, crowned by a horse race, became the annual Oktoberfest.

events.title: Pedro I is acclaimed Emperor of Brazil
events.description: In Rio de Janeiro, Prince Pedro was acclaimed constitutional Emperor of Brazil, five weeks after declaring independence from Portugal. Brazil became the only lasting monarchy in independent Latin America.
events.html: In Rio de Janeiro, Prince Pedro was acclaimed constitutional Emperor of Brazil, five weeks after declaring independence from Portugal. Brazil became the only lasting monarchy in independent Latin America.

events.title: Germans execute the British nurse Edith Cavell
events.description: A German firing squad in Brussels executed Edith Cavell, who had helped some 200 Allied soldiers escape occupied Belgium. Her death caused international outrage and became a powerful theme of Allied propaganda.

events.title: Bombings in Bali kill 202 people
events.description: Militants of Jemaah Islamiyah bombed two nightclubs in the tourist district of Kuta, Bali, killing 202 people from 21 countries. It remains the deadliest terrorist attack in Indonesia's history.
